purpose: Observed capability gaps and unspecified contracts, separate from confirmed defects. Raw checks remain visible.

questions.observed: Click target identity is correct; event index is the physical DOM index after reorder/cloning.
questions.decisionNeeded: Document whether click index is logical or physical. Existing event documentation leaves it unspecified.

questions.topic: loop auto implementation and selection policy
questions.observed: Declared string mode does not activate looping for 7 slides/perPage1.
questions.decisionNeeded: Reconcile the advertised mode with implementation and define its content threshold.

questions.observed: Interrupted target0 returns to6. Implementation saves a DOM target then passes it to logical scrollTo.
questions.decisionNeeded: Specify resume-target versus nearest-snap behavior before imposing a final index expectation. Subsequent clone branch is blocked.

questions.topic: Nested instance behavior inside visible loop clones
questions.observed: Original child remains functional after ordinary reorder; visible deep clones have no live child instance and may retain inert copied controls.
questions.decisionNeeded: Define clone initialization and lifecycle responsibilities for nested sliders.

questions.observed: Explicit late start on old autoplay controls restarts its owner and changes a root reused by a new slider.
questions.decisionNeeded: Specify whether controls obtained before destroy must become inert or calls are unsupported.

questions.observed: Generated span bullets have no Tab entry; keyboard activation tail cannot run.
questions.decisionNeeded: Define accessible generated pagination behavior. This is separate from the documented unimplemented keyboard option.

questions.topic: Fractional pagination and terminal selected card policy
questions.observed: Existing legacy test intentionally expects fractional total2.5. The audit separately detects inconsistent active identity.
questions.decisionNeeded: Define fractional position/page totals and terminal selected-card semantics without treating fractional text alone as a defect.

questions.topic: Ordinary drag after the author root releases pointer capture
questions.observed: Browser delivered lostpointercapture from the actual owner. dragStart1/dragEnd0 and dragging class remain. Other pointercancel/touchcancel branches pass.
questions.decisionNeeded: Specify whether losing capture must end/reset Tvist drag or document-level tracking intentionally continues. Gesture cleanup tail after contract-gap is blocked.

questions.topic: Pagination between snap points in unsnapped free drag
questions.observed: Committed realIndex remains0 while nearest rendered card1; exact snap navigation and teardown are verified. Scrollbar physical-position violations are tracked separately in035.
questions.decisionNeeded: Specify committed versus nearest-card page semantics for freeSnap:false. Audit accepts both at interim position and records ambiguity only after other non-scrollbar checks finish.
